messages.content: Predict one human decision in a three-person public-goods experiment lasting 10 rounds. Roles are A, B1 and B2. A’s contribution has productivity 1, while each B player’s contribution has productivity 2. After all contributions are submitted, the productive public-good size is A’s contribution plus twice B1’s contribution plus twice B2’s contribution. Every group member receives 0.4 times that size. Each person also keeps the tokens left in their current budget after contributing. Thus a round payoff is that person’s current token budget minus their contribution plus the common public-good return. Contributions are chosen simultaneously, so no other person’s current contribution is visible when deciding. All group contributions and all three payoffs are reported after the round. All 10 round payoffs are added for payment, at EUR 0.05 per token. There is no communication. At the start of every round A has 30 tokens and each B has 15. Before anyone contributes, A makes one unconditional allocation choice: give no tokens; give 30 to B1; give 30 to B2; give 15 to each B; give 15 only to B1; or give 15 only to B2. Transferred tokens leave A’s budget and enter the named B budgets. Both B players learn A’s realized choice before the simultaneous contribution stage. This is one joint allocation, not two separate choices. The same three people remain together throughout all 10 rounds; their A/B1/B2 labels stay consistent across the feedback history. Predict A’s allocation now, before anyone contributes. Output exactly one JSON object with integer token amounts to the two recipients, using keys B1 and B2; the pair must be one of (0,0), (30,0), (0,30), (15,15), (15,0), (0,15). No explanation.

Personal descriptors: birth year 1988; gender Male; semester number 10. These stable descriptors were collected after the game. No later satisfaction, fairness or strategy reports are provided.
